decisions.reason: As a core safety-shoe line it still fits the firm’s main business and can be carried at relatively low option cost, but after two years with no strong strategic signal its market value should now be clearer and the risk of pruning is higher.

The ergonomic safety-shoe series remains closely aligned with the firm’s innovation positioning and core footwear capabilities, so management would likely keep it while continuing to learn, though the extra year modestly raises the chance of withdrawal if demand has disappointed.

Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship direction and complements the broader footwear portfolio, management would be inclined to retain it, with only a limited withdrawal risk if results have fallen short after another year.
